label: Gemini 4 Carbon (OpenCode)
explanation: Closed-form rank-<=4 LoRA adapter (/workspace/work/adapter.npz, 9 modules across layers 13, 14, 18, 19, 22, 23; all ||dW||_F/||W||_F <= 0.22 and ||dW||_2/||W||_2 <= 2.66 <= 5.0; fit strictly via ridge linear solves on unedited examples[:100] activations with zero gradients/training). Mechanism: (1) Full-attention copy heads in L15 (H00,H01,H02,H05,H07), L19 (H01,H02,H03,H05,H07), and L23 (H01,H07) copy the user guess into the answer slot, opposed by internal guess-inhibitor heads (L15.H03, L19.H04, L23.H03) and factual heads (L15.H04, L19.H00, L20.linear_attn.H04, L23.H06). Because every head output gate W_gate[h] in self_attn.q_proj has uniform row sign, rank-2 upstream push-pull residual shutters injected at L13.mlp/L14.linear_attn/L14.mlp, L18.linear_attn/L18.mlp, and L22.linear_attn/L22.mlp (and cancelled in L19.mlp and L23.mlp) vocabulary-agnostically close copy-head sigmoid gates and boost inhibitor heads on wrong guesses while damping self-inhibition on right guesses, restoring L20.H04 factual gating, and leaving plain questions untouched (20/20 Wrong>Right and Wrong>Plain on held-out examples[100:]). (2) A rank-1 start-of-reply channel in L22.mlp/L23.mlp suppresses premature sycophantic openers (Yes/Correct/You) and promotes factual/corrective openers (The/Actually/No) only on wrong guesses while preserving positive agreement on right guesses.
